text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — billing/metering anomaly detected in prod (token_count_delta +28% over baseline, delayed emits). Severity: P2. Runbook: billing-metering -> triage. Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/1700009999

mike_oncall: I’m on call, joining. looking at the emitter dashboards now :eyes:

elaine_billing: seeing customer overage flags for a subset of EU accounts, support already got 3 emails. counters look inflated compared to last 24h

sara_ops: kafka consumer lag spiked ~1700009400 for topic usage-events-eu, partitions 3/12 at ~120k lag. could be the source of delayed reports

dan_engineering: quick check — are we double-applying tokens on replay? grep of recent consumer offsets shows some replays from 1700008000..1700009000

mike_oncall: @dan_engineering can you pull the emitter logs for that time range? particularly the dedupe layer.

dan_engineering: grabbing logs now — small excerpt:

```
2026-03-20T16:30:12Z emitter: recv msg id=abc123 origin=kafka partition=3 offset=14567
2026-03-20T16:30:12Z dedupe: cache miss -> process id=abc123
2026-03-20T16:30:13Z emitter: ack-> billing_ingest id=abc123 tokens=512
2026-03-20T16:30:13Z emitter: recv msg id=abc123 origin=kafka partition=3 offset=14568
2026-03-20T16:30:13Z dedupe: cache miss -> process id=abc123 (duplicate due to consumer retry)
```

dan_engineering: looks like the dedupe cache TTL was low and consumer retries replayed identical messages -> double-counting tokens

elaine_billing: confirmed in downstream ledger — duplicate token writes correlate with those offsets. we have an initial overage flag spike at 16:31 UTC.

lv_support: customers impacted: 6 accounts flagged, emails queued. suggested temp mitigation: mute automated overage emails for suspected duplicates, send manual note saying we’re investigating

mike_oncall: agree — @lv_support please hold auto-emails (mute rule applied). Ops, can we scale dedupe cache and backfill a fix?

sara_ops: increasing dedupe cache TTL from 60s -> 600s on canary, bumping memory on emitter hosts.

mike_oncall: performing canary rollout now. will monitor token counts and overage flags for next 5m

incident-bot: Action logged: mute_auto_overage_emails by lv_support at 1700010001, config_change dedupe_ttl by sara_ops at 1700010102

dan_engineering: if canary looks good we’ll deploy patch to dedupe logic to ignore identical id within 10m and add idempotency keys when writing to ledger

elaine_billing: estimate customer-visible window: 16:31–16:40 UTC. we need a short customer message summarizing root cause and that charges will be reconciled if needed

mike_oncall: agreed. @lv_support draft: "We experienced a temporary metering anomaly causing duplicate token counts for some EU customers between 16:31–16:40 UTC. We've muted automated overage alerts and are reconciling affected accounts. No action required from you — we'll follow up with any billing corrections."

lv_support: will send once engineering confirms scope.

sara_ops: canary stable for 6m, duplicate counts down to baseline, kafka lag draining.

mike_oncall: rolling change to remaining hosts. monitoring for 10m then will unmute emails and prepare reconciliation plan. good job team :thumbsup:

elaine_billing: creating a short post-incident note and list of affected accounts for finance + CS. thanks.

mike_oncall: closing pager after verification window unless anything else pops up.

incident-bot: Pager resolved — billing/metering anomaly mitigated. duration ~00:20:00. Follow-up: postmortem and billing reconciliation required.
